name: futuristic
label: Futuristic
css: .style-futuristic { --slide-primary: #3B82F6; --slide-secondary: #8B5CF6; --slide-surface: #FFFFFF; --slide-text: #111827; --slide-spacing: 16px; background: var(--slide-surface); color: var(--slide-text); font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; padding: var(--slide-spacing); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; } .style-futuristic::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; width: 400px; height: 400px; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.08; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; } .style-futuristic .hook { font-family: 'Audiowide', cursive; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--slide-text); margin: 0; padding: 0; letter-spacing: -2px; max-width: 90%; } .style-futuristic .text { font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--slide-text); margin: 0; padding: 0; max-width: 85%; } .style-futuristic .step { position: absolute; top: 32px; right: 32px; font-family: 'Audiowide', cursive; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-text); opacity: 0.06; line-height: 1; margin: 0; } .style-futuristic .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 24px; left: 24px; font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-text); opacity: 0.7; letter-spacing: 1px; margin: 0; } .slide-code.style-futuristic { --slide-surface: #0F172A; --slide-text: #F8FAFC; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0F172A 0%, #1E293B 100%); background-attachment: fixed; } .slide-code.style-futuristic::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.12; } .slide-code.style-futuristic .hook, .slide-code.style-futuristic .text, .slide-code.style-futuristic .step, .slide-code.style-futuristic .brand { color: var(--slide-text); } .slide-code.style-futuristic .hook { text-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); } .slide-insight.style-futuristic { --slide-surface: #111827; --slide-text: #F3F4F6; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #111827 0%, #1F2937 100%); background-attachment: fixed; } .slide-insight.style-futuristic::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-secondary) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-futuristic .hook, .slide-insight.style-futuristic .text, .slide-insight.style-futuristic .step, .slide-insight.style-futuristic .brand { color: var(--slide-text); } .slide-insight.style-futuristic .insight-text { font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; color: #FFFFFF; margin: 0; padding: 0; max-width: 85%; letter-spacing: 0.5px; } .slide-insight.style-futuristic .hook { color: var(--slide-primary); text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4); }
